questions.cardText:
[Anthropology] Why would some Chinese people intentionally give their children self-deprecating names?
A. To protect their children
B. To paradoxically signify wealth
C. To create a social lubricant
Answer: A. This practice stems from the belief that self-deprecating names, such as “dog’s leftover,” can make children less attractive to malevolent spirits.
questions.de: Manche chinesischen Familien gaben Kindern traditionell absichtlich abstoßende Namen wie „Hundereste“ – um sie wovor zu schützen?
questions.en: Some Chinese families traditionally gave children deliberately unpleasant names, such as “dog's leftover”, to protect them from what?

timeline.labelEn: Sima Xiangru, Han-dynasty poet originally named Sima Quanzi (犬子, “dog son”)
timeline.labelDe: Sima Xiangru, Dichter der Han-Dynastie, ursprünglich Sima Quanzi (犬子, „Hundesohn“) genannt

questions.notes: Card correct: Wikipedia (Chinese name) says unpleasant milk names were chosen to ward off demons, and deliberately unpleasant given names (e.g. Taiwanese 'Pig Shit') to tell evil spirits the child was not worth their trouble; the practice is now largely supplanted. Timeline: Sima Xiangru (c. 179–117 BC), originally named Sima Quanzi 犬子 'dog son' (Wikipedia: Sima Xiangru), a classic example of such a name.

questions.cardText:
[Psychology] What is the primary difference between sensation and perception?
A. Sensation interprets stimuli, and perception detects them
B. Sensation detects stimuli, and perception interprets them
C. Sensation happens in the brain, and perception happens in the organs such as the eyes and nose
Answer: B.
questions.de: In der Psychologie ist Empfindung das Erfassen von Reizen durch die Sinnesorgane – was leistet die Wahrnehmung dann mit diesen Sinnesinformationen?
questions.en: In psychology, sensation is the detection of stimuli by the sense organs; what does perception then do with that sensory information?

timeline.labelEn: Gustav Theodor Fechner publishes Elemente der Psychophysik, founding the measurement of sensation
timeline.labelDe: Gustav Theodor Fechner veröffentlicht die „Elemente der Psychophysik“ und begründet die Messung von Empfindungen

questions.notes: Card correct: perception is the identification, interpretation and organization of sensory information (Wikipedia: Perception), while sensation is gathering information through the detection of stimuli (Wikipedia: Sense). Timeline from Wikipedia: Psychophysics (Fechner, 1860).
